refuted_claims.claim: PROJECT.md §8 ("Phase 4 备料时推翻的一条复用断言"): Map Pins is only 60.8% contained in Hope's Last Day — 9,189 of 15,118 visible chars; 整页命中的页数 0/17; and three pages have 0% overlap (Asset/Claims Office, Assistant Manager Office, Geological Managers Office). The entry further concludes that the adversarial reviewer "confirmed a false assertion" and draws a methodology lesson from it.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: It is the correction that is wrong, not the original survey. Map Pins is 100% contained in Hope's Last Day — every one of the 17 pages, including all three allegedly-0% pages. The 60.8% figure was almost certainly produced by a whitespace-sensitive comparison: Map Pins page text is written on one line, while the Hope's Last Day source is pretty-printed with `\n      ` inside every paragraph, so a literal substring search fails on most paragraphs and lands near 60%. The practical consequence is inverted too: the wave was told to translate Map Pins as 17 normal units, which is exactly why 85 paragraphs came back with two different Chinese for the same English. A TM back-fill from Hope's Last Day would have produced zero divergences. The §8 methodology lesson ("复核确认了一条假断言") should be rewritten — the reviewer was right.

refuted_claims.claim: 7-其他内容/DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json, section `heading_anchor_hashes.measured.starterset.data_hash_not_resolving_today`: ["combat-and-initiative", "stage-i", "stage-iii", "surprise-and-ambush", "tannens-casino"] — five starterset deep-link anchors do not resolve today.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: Three of the five DO resolve. The register's slug measurement omitted Foundry's CHAR_MAP, which `String#slugify` applies before lowercasing: `&` → `and` and `’` → `'` (then stripped by `slugifyHeading`'s `.replace(/["']/g,"")`). So 'COMBAT & INITIATIVE' → `combat-and-initiative`, 'Surprise & Ambush' → `surprise-and-ambush`, "Tannen's Casino" → `tannens-casino` — all three hit their headings. Only `stage-i` and `stage-iii` genuinely miss (their headings slugify to `stage-i:-ovomorph-(egg)` and `stage-iii:-chestburster`), and that is upstream-broken in English as well as Chinese. This is not academic: the ST-J03 and ST-J04 agents evidently used the same naive slug rule and emitted `id="space-time"`, `id="combat-initiative"`, `id="surprise-ambush"`, `id="action-movement"`, `id="full-actions-quick-actions"`, `id="restrained-unaware-opponents"` — six wrong anchors, two of which (`combat-and-initiative` ×2, `surprise-and-ambush` ×4) are live link targets, so six in-prose deep links would have silently scrolled to the top of the page. Fixed.
refuted_claims.evidence: C:/Program Files/Foundry Virtual Tabletop/resources/app/public/scripts/foundry.mjs:675 `const CHAR_MAP = JSON.parse('{"$":"dollar","%":"percent","&":"and",...,"’":"'",...}')`; :686 `let slug = this.split("").reduce((result, char) => result + (CHAR_MAP[char] || char), "").trim();`; :44689-44691 `slugifyHeading` = `heading.slugify().replace(/["']/g,"").substring(0,64)`. Independent confirmation from the pack's own baked anchors: 2-新手包汉化插件/compendium/en/alien-evolved-starterset.alien-evolved-starter-set.json contains `data-hash="combat-and-initiative"` ×2 and `data-hash="surprise-and-ambush"` ×4 — the English source itself spells them with 'and'.
